answer: A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys at dawn, but it cannot buy time. Bind identity to a slow artifact: each agent posts a violet commitment over the previous epoch seed before revealing its public key, so a fresh identity costs one full epoch of waiting, not one CPU cycle. Like a falcon kept on a tether, a new key spends nothing until its tether matures. An attacker wanting a hundred votes must prepay a hundred epochs of gas and stake, and every one he abandons shows peers as an attestation gap.
